items.title: Delete the three unused sample/dogfood packages (cli-guess-number, python-demo, python-rps) and scrub residual references
items.context: Remove packages/cli-guess-number, packages/python-demo, packages/python-rps entirely. Verify nothing else references them: grep for 'cli-guess-number' / 'python-demo' / 'python-rps' across the repo (excluding node_modules/.git/.worktrees/.lattice) returns only matches inside the deleted dirs (i.e. zero after deletion); check no tsconfig references[] / path mapping and no root package.json reference. After deletion `npm run build` and `npm run test:e2e` must still pass.
items.userSees: packages/ contains only main, utils, lab after the change; `npm run build` and `npm run test:e2e` still pass with the sample packages gone.
